title: Mixed conditionals
note: past condition + present result / present condition + past result · first draft night/2026-08-06

items.en: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.
items.cz: Kdybych se víc učil, měl bych teď lepší práci.
items.gap: If I ____ studied harder, I would have a better job now.
accepts: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.
items.explanation: Past condition (had + past participle) + present result (would + base).
items.explanation_cz: Minulá podmínka (had + past participle) + přítomný výsledek (would).

items.en: If she were taller, she would have joined the team last year.
items.cz: Kdyby byla vyšší, loni by se dostala do týmu.
items.gap: If she ____ taller, she would have joined the team last year.
accepts: If she were taller, she would have joined the team last year.
items.explanation: Present unreal if (were) + past result (would have + past participle).
items.explanation_cz: Přítomné nereal. if + minulý výsledek (would have).

items.en: If we had left earlier, we would be there now.
items.cz: Kdybychom odešli dřív, teď bychom tam byli.
items.gap: If we ____ left earlier, we would be there now.
accepts: If we had left earlier, we would be there now.
items.explanation: Past cause → present result: if + past perfect, would + base now.

items.en: If I spoke French, I would have taken that job in Paris.
items.cz: Kdybych mluvil francouzsky, vzal bych tu práci v Paříži.
items.gap: If I ____ French, I would have taken that job in Paris.
accepts: If I spoke French, I would have taken that job in Paris.
items.explanation: Present skill missing → past missed chance: if + past, would have.
items.explanation_cz: Chybějící přítomná dovednost → minulá ztracená šance.

items.en: If you had told me, I would not be angry now.
items.cz: Kdybys mi to řekl, teď bych se nezlobila.
items.gap: If you ____ told me, I would not be angry now.
accepts: If you had told me, I would not be angry now.
items.explanation: Past if + present result (negative).

items.en: If he were more careful, he would not have crashed.
items.cz: Kdyby byl opatrnější, nebyl by naboural.
items.gap: If he ____ more careful, he would not have crashed.
accepts: If he were more careful, he would not have crashed.
items.explanation: Character/habit now → past consequence: if + past, would have.

items.en: If they had invested then, they would be rich today.
items.cz: Kdyby tehdy investovali, dnes by byli bohatí.
items.gap: If they ____ invested then, they would be rich today.
accepts: If they had invested then, they would be rich today.
items.explanation: Past investment → present wealth.

items.en: If I knew her number, I would have called her yesterday.
items.cz: Kdybych znal její číslo, včera bych jí zavolal.
items.gap: If I ____ her number, I would have called her yesterday.
accepts: If I knew her number, I would have called her yesterday.
items.explanation: Present lack of knowledge → past no-call.

items.en: If we lived closer, we would have visited more often.
items.cz: Kdybychom bydleli blíž, navštěvovali bychom se častěji.
items.gap: If we ____ closer, we would have visited more often.
accepts: If we lived closer, we would have visited more often.
items.explanation: Present situation → past frequency (would have).

items.en: If she had accepted, she would work here now.
items.cz: Kdyby přijala, teď by tu pracovala.
items.gap: If she ____ accepted, she would work here now.
accepts: If she had accepted, she would work here now.
items.explanation: Past decision → present job situation.

items.en: If I had not missed the train, I would be at the meeting now.
items.cz: Kdybych nezmeškal vlak, teď bych byl na schůzce.
items.gap: If I ____ not missed the train, I would be at the meeting now.
accepts: If I had not missed the train, I would be at the meeting now.
If I hadn't missed the train, I would be at the meeting now.
items.explanation: Past mistake → present absence: mixed past → present.

items.en: If she liked cities, she would have moved to London.
items.cz: Kdyby měla ráda města, přestěhovala by se do Londýna.
items.gap: If she ____ cities, she would have moved to London.
accepts: If she liked cities, she would have moved to London.
items.explanation: Present preference → past life choice not taken.
items.explanation_cz: Přítomná preference → minulá volba, která se nestala.

items.en: If you had followed the map, we would not be lost now.
items.cz: Kdybys se řídil mapou, teď bychom nebyli ztracení.
items.gap: If you ____ followed the map, we would not be lost now.
accepts: If you had followed the map, we would not be lost now.
If you had followed the map, we wouldn't be lost now.
items.explanation: Past action not done → present problem.

items.en: If he were honest, he would not have lied to us.
items.cz: Kdyby byl upřímný, nelhal by nám.
items.gap: If he ____ honest, he would not have lied to us.
accepts: If he were honest, he would not have lied to us.
If he were honest, he wouldn't have lied to us.
items.explanation: Present character unreal → past behaviour.

items.en: If we had bought the flat, we would own it now.
items.cz: Kdybychom ten byt koupili, teď bychom ho vlastnili.
items.gap: If we ____ bought the flat, we would own it now.
accepts: If we had bought the flat, we would own it now.
items.explanation: Past purchase not made → present ownership missing.
items.explanation_cz: Minulý nákup se nestal → chybí vlastnictví teď.

items.en: If I did not hate flying, I would have gone with you.
items.cz: Kdybych neměl rád létání, šel bych s tebou.
items.gap: If I ____ not hate flying, I would have gone with you.
accepts: If I did not hate flying, I would have gone with you.
If I didn't hate flying, I would have gone with you.
items.explanation: Present dislike → past trip missed: if + past, would have.

items.en: If they had won the match, they would be in the final now.
items.cz: Kdyby vyhráli zápas, teď by byli ve finále.
items.gap: If they ____ won the match, they would be in the final now.
accepts: If they had won the match, they would be in the final now.
items.explanation: Past sports result → present situation.

items.en: If she had more experience, she would have got the job.
items.cz: Kdyby měla víc zkušeností, tu práci by dostala.
items.gap: If she ____ more experience, she would have got the job.
accepts: If she had more experience, she would have got the job.
If she had more experience, she would have gotten the job.
items.explanation: Present state (lack of experience) → past missed offer. Gap is if-clause past form.

items.en: If I had taken that course, I would understand this better now.
items.cz: Kdybych ten kurz absolvoval, teď bych tomu víc rozuměl.
items.gap: If I had taken that course, I ____ understand this better now.
accepts: If I had taken that course, I would understand this better now.
items.explanation: Past if → present result needs would + base (not would have).
items.explanation_cz: Minulé if → přítomný výsledek: would + základ (ne would have).

items.en: If you were not so busy, you would have come to the party.
items.cz: Kdybys nebyl tak zaneprázdněný, přišel bys na večírek.
items.gap: If you ____ not so busy, you would have come to the party.
accepts: If you were not so busy, you would have come to the party.
If you weren't so busy, you would have come to the party.
items.explanation: Present busyness → past absence: if + past, would have.

items.en: If we had checked the weather, we would not be wet now.
items.cz: Kdybychom se podívali na počasí, teď bychom nebyli mokří.
items.gap: If we had checked the weather, we would not ____ wet now.
accepts: If we had checked the weather, we would not be wet now.
If we had checked the weather, we wouldn't be wet now.
items.explanation: Present result after past if: would + be (not would have been).
items.explanation_cz: Přítomný výsledek po minulém if: would + be.

items.en: If he owned a car, he would have driven us home.
items.cz: Kdyby měl auto, odvezl by nás domů.
items.gap: If he ____ a car, he would have driven us home.
accepts: If he owned a car, he would have driven us home.
items.explanation: Present ownership missing → past lift not given.
items.explanation_cz: Chybějící vlastnictví teď → minulá jízda se nestala.

items.en: If she had not left early, she would still be here.
items.cz: Kdyby neodešla brzy, pořád by tu byla.
items.gap: If she ____ not left early, she would still be here.
accepts: If she had not left early, she would still be here.
If she hadn't left early, she would still be here.
items.explanation: Past departure → present absence.

items.en: If I trusted him, I would have told him the truth.
items.cz: Kdybych mu věřil, řekl bych mu pravdu.
items.gap: If I ____ him, I would have told him the truth.
accepts: If I trusted him, I would have told him the truth.
items.explanation: Present (lack of) trust → past disclosure not made.

items.en: If they had repaired the roof, the room would be dry now.
items.cz: Kdyby opravili střechu, pokoj by teď byl suchý.
items.gap: If they had repaired the roof, the room ____ be dry now.
accepts: If they had repaired the roof, the room would be dry now.
items.explanation: Past if → present state: would + base, not would have.
items.explanation_cz: Minulé if → přítomný stav: would + základ.

items.en: If you spoke Spanish, you would have understood the film.
items.cz: Kdybys uměl španělsky, filmu bys rozuměl.
items.gap: If you ____ Spanish, you would have understood the film.
accepts: If you spoke Spanish, you would have understood the film.
items.explanation: Present language skill → past comprehension.

items.en: If I had saved more money, I would not need a loan now.
items.cz: Kdybych ušetřil víc peněz, teď bych nepotřeboval půjčku.
items.gap: If I had saved more money, I would not ____ a loan now.
accepts: If I had saved more money, I would not need a loan now.
If I had saved more money, I wouldn't need a loan now.
items.explanation: Present result after past if: would + need (present).
items.explanation_cz: Přítomný výsledek po minulém if: would + need.

items.en: If she were not afraid of dogs, she would have kept that puppy.
items.cz: Kdyby se nebála psů, to štěně by si nechala.
items.gap: If she ____ not afraid of dogs, she would have kept that puppy.
accepts: If she were not afraid of dogs, she would have kept that puppy.
If she weren't afraid of dogs, she would have kept that puppy.
items.explanation: Present fear → past decision not taken.
items.explanation_cz: Přítomný strach → minulé rozhodnutí se nestalo.

items.en: If we had not argued, we would still be friends.
items.cz: Kdybychom se nepohádali, pořád bychom byli přátelé.
items.gap: If we ____ not argued, we would still be friends.
accepts: If we had not argued, we would still be friends.
If we hadn't argued, we would still be friends.
items.explanation: Past quarrel → present relationship state.

items.en: If he lived in this city, he would have met us last week.
items.cz: Kdyby bydlel v tomhle městě, minulej týden by se s námi potkal.
items.gap: If he ____ in this city, he would have met us last week.
accepts: If he lived in this city, he would have met us last week.
items.explanation: Present residence unreal → past meeting missed.
items.explanation_cz: Přítomné bydlení nereal. → minulé setkání se nestalo.

cards.title: What it is
cards.body: Mixed conditionals combine **different times** in if and result — not pure second or pure third.
points: Use when time in the if-clause and time in the result are not the same

cards.title: Form (short)
points: Past → present: If + past perfect, would + base (now)
Present → past: If + past simple / were, would have + past participle
Negative: hadn't / wouldn't / weren't as needed

rows: If I had studied, I would have a job now.
If I spoke French, I would have taken the job.

cards.title: When to use which
points: Something wrong in the past still matters now → past if + present would
A present fact blocked a past action → present if + would have
Pure imaginary present → second conditional (not mixed)
Pure past regret → third conditional (not mixed)

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: would have in both clauses when one time is present
Using will / present simple in unreal if
Forcing third conditional when the result is clearly now
Forcing second when the result is clearly past

cards.title: Quick check
cards.body: Label the time of the if-clause and the time of the result.
points: Present result needs would + base; past result needs would have + past participle
